source_gaps: The Apple page 118226 gives rotation lock steps only for iPhone without a Home button; no iPad steps and no steps for iPhone with a Home button were found on official pages. The Apple iOS 14 guide (support.apple.com/guide/iphone) names a Lock Orientation button, a different version, so it was not used. The Google page names no Android version or phone brand; the Settings labels may differ by phone maker.

source_refs.title: Rotate the screen on your iPhone or iPod touch - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Rotate the screen on an iPhone without a Home button
source_refs.applicability: iPhone without a Home button; the page says some apps don't support rotation
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Some apps don't support rotation, so your screen might not rotate even if Portrait Orientation Lock isn't turned on.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone without a Home button: Swipe down from the top-right corner of your screen to open Control Center. Tap the 'Portrait Orientation Lock' button and confirm it is off. Close Control Center. Turn the iPhone sideways. If you don't see the 'Portrait Orientation Lock' button, learn how to access more controls in Control Center. Some apps don't support rotation, so your screen might not rotate even if Portrait Orientation Lock isn't turned on.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; the step wording and labels are paraphrased from the named section; the verified excerpt and the 'Swipe down' and 'access more controls' sentences are quoted exactly.

source_refs.title: How to make your screen rotate all by itself - Android Accessibility Help
source_refs.section: How to make your screen rotate all by itself
source_refs.applicability: Android; the page names no Android version
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you use TalkBack, you must turn off auto-rotate, because rotating the screen can interrupt spoken feedback.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Open your device's Settings app. Tap 'Display & touch'. Select 'Auto-rotate screen' to turn it on or off. If you use TalkBack, you must turn off auto-rotate.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; steps paraphrased from the named section with the labels kept; the TalkBack sentence is shortened from an exact quote.
